static_traits.name: Li Na
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude; clear expression, good organization; able to cooperate; tending to avoid or Displace when touching on swimsuit/swimming topics; subjective feelings dominated by Anxiety and discomfort

basic_info.main_problem: I have a Fear of wearing swimsuits, stemming from a near-drowning traumatic experience; whenever thinking about swimsuits or swimming I feel Anxiety and discomfort, and have long avoided water activities, affecting my participation in and enjoyment of life.
basic_info.core_demands: I realized this fear hinders me from participating in activities and enjoying life, and I hope to resolve this problem through counseling.
growth_experiences: A few years ago while vacationing at the seaside with friends, shortly after entering the water, encountered the predicament of 'unable to save myself, unable to stay afloat', feeling intense panic and vulnerability, and was rescued by someone minutes later; the event carried high stress intensity and left a lasting negative imprint in memory, causing me to develop Significant anxiety and avoidance toward wearing swimsuits and approaching water since, believing 'that trip was ruined because of it'.

core_beliefs: I am not safe near water
I am vulnerable, unable to protect myself

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I wear a swimsuit or go to the water, I will encounter danger again like on that trip, and the whole experience will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Changes the topic or finds excuses to avoid related activities and discussions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Bad things will happen; I might drown again

special_situations.event: Near bodies of water (seaside, swimming pool)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If safety cannot be guaranteed 100%, it equals danger
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying away from water, not approaching the seaside or pools
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Either completely safe or very dangerous

special_situations.event: Seeing others swim or wear swimsuits
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any scene involving water is unsafe for me, and I will get into trouble too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Refusing to take part in any water activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Any situation related to water is unsafe

special_situations.event: Reminded of or recalls the 'nearly drowned' experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once triggered memories occur, it shows water and swimsuits themselves are dangerous, and disaster may happen again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stopping thinking, Displacing attention to avoid emotional escalation

core_conflict.wish: Longing to freely and safely participate in water-related leisure activities, enjoying life and time with relatives and friends
core_conflict.fear: Fearing losing control again and encountering danger (such as drowning), possibly even causing serious consequences
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety and control by avoiding water-related situations and topics

object_relations.object_representation: A dangerous environment that may cause harm (the scene indicated by waters/swimsuits)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about swimsuits, swimming, beaches, or being near water
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating related topics or situations as danger about to repeat itself, believing they will lose control and be hurt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle, supportive tone; first affirm their intention of protecting themselves, then with open questions gently explore their worries; avoid blaming or forcing, invite them to describe the present bodily feelings and thoughts, and gradually bring the topic back to bearable concrete details.

manifestations: The life-threatening 'near-drowning' experience persisting in memory, triggering worry about encountering disaster again
outcomes: Intense Fear and Anxiety about water/swimsuits
Significant avoidant behavior narrowing life scope

manifestations: Fear restricts choices of participation in water-related activities, affecting leisure and connection with family and friends
outcomes: Experiences and activities decrease, missing opportunities to enjoy life

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: When swimsuit/swimming topics arise, changes the topic or avoids with jokes/excuses
In social scenes, proactively avoids water-related activity arrangements

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Believing others may not understand one's Fear and choosing not to mention it
Excessively worries before water-related scenes and self-limits participation

positive_force: Having an Average Social support network (friends and family, though not yet talked about this Fear)
Having clear motivation to overcome Fear in order to participate in activities more freely
Willing to try journaling thoughts and starting small (like first approaching water, not forcing entry into water)
negative_force: Long-term avoidance of water scenarios and related topics, Reinforcing Fear associations
Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking patterns
Intense Anxiety and predictions of worst cases
Staying Silent toward the support network, reducing use of external resources

target_behavior.behavior: Intense Fear and avoidance of wearing swimsuits and water situations (accompanied by Anxiety/discomfort/occasional panic)
antecedent: Thinking about or discussing swimsuits / swimming / beaches
Being near water such as the seaside or a pool
Seeing others wear swimsuits or swim
Being triggered to recall the 'near-drowning' experience
target_behavior.core_reason: Traumatic memories of near-drowning and catastrophic Anticipation of danger happening again (core beliefs of self-vulnerability and unsafety)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome things (potential danger and intense Anxiety) to maintain short-term security and control
target_behavior.consequence: Misses leisure activities and connection with family and friends; enjoyment of life and participation decline; avoidance of water-related environments gradually intensifies the maintenance of fear
